hints.title: Multi-Source Distance Diffusion Obstacle
hints.text: Running separate shortest path searches from every empty room duplicates work whenever paths overlap. How can initiating simultaneous wave expansion from all gates fill distance values in a single pass?

hints.title: Breadth Level Distance Invariant
hints.text: Simultaneously expanding level by level from all gate cells guarantees that the first time an empty room is reached, the path length is minimal.

hints.title: Multi-Source Wave Expansion Procedure
hints.text: Find all gate cells (rooms[r][c] == 0) and enqueue their coordinates. While the collection is not empty, pop coordinate (r, c). For each 4-directional neighbor (nr, nc): if valid and rooms[nr][nc] == 2147483647 (empty room), set rooms[nr][nc] = rooms[r][c] + 1 and enqueue (nr, nc).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Every room is visited and populated at most once through multi-source expansion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Independent searches from each empty room take O((M * N)^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Queue memory holds at most M * N cells in the worst-case perimeter wave.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizing multi-source breadth-first expansion starting from gates rather than rooms.
